# Test recording scripts

Record these five invented meetings yourself. Use 2026-11-18 as the meeting date so the due dates match. `tests/test_scripts.py` checks each script against the expected counts.

## Recording 1: Sprint planning

Format: WAV upload. Expected: 2 decisions, 4 action items.

> Thanks for joining sprint planning, everyone. We decided to release version two on December 1. We agreed to hold the bug bash in the main lab. Maya will finish the login page by Friday. Jordan will write the API tests by next Tuesday. Priya needs to update the deployment guide by November 25. Leo is going to review the pull requests by tomorrow. That is everything for today.

## Recording 2: Student group check-in

Format: MP3 upload. Expected: 1 decision, 3 action items.

> Hi everyone, this is our capstone check-in. We agreed to use the library study room for rehearsal. Nina will draft the introduction by next Tuesday. Omar will build the slides by the end of the week. Grace has to proofread the report in three days. See you all soon.

## Recording 3: Budget review

Format: WAV upload. Expected: 2 decisions, 3 action items, 2 marked for review.

> We decided to cut the travel budget by ten percent. We approved the new software subscription. Daniel will send the revised spreadsheet by Monday. Someone needs to call the vendor by Thursday. Alicia will look into cheaper hosting.

## Recording 4: Noisy stand-up

Format: browser recording in a noisy room. Expected: 1 decision, 2 action items.

> Quick stand-up before class. We agreed to move the demo to the larger room. Ben will fix the upload bug by tonight. Tara will test the mobile layout by tomorrow.

## Recording 5: Status update

Format: MP3 upload. Expected: 0 decisions, 0 action items.

> Here is my weekly status update. The homepage redesign went well last week. Maria finished the customer survey on Monday. We will see how the numbers look next month. The new office might open in the spring. Nothing else is assigned right now.
